title: Scabies treatment
what: Scabies is a skin disease caused by a tiny mite. The skin itches badly, especially at night. It is treated with a cream or lotion, usually for the whole family at once.
why: When there is severe itching, especially at night, and a fine rash between the fingers, on the wrists and on the belly.
duration: the visit usually takes 15 to 20 minutes; treatment usually takes a few days, sometimes repeated after a week
tell_doctor: How long and where it itches
Whether family members or close contacts itch
If a child is being treated: age and weight

prepare.title: Family
prepare.text: Everyone who lives together needs treatment, even if they do not itch. The doctor will say.

prepare.title: Bedding
prepare.text: Have clean bed linen and clothes ready to change into after treatment.

prepare.title: Medicine
prepare.text: The doctor prescribes the product and the plan. Do not use folk remedies.

bring: Information about close contacts who also itch
steps: The doctor asks questions and examines the skin
Sometimes looks at the skin under magnification or takes a scraping
Prescribes a product and explains how to apply it
At home, the product is applied to the whole body from the neck to the heels
It is left on for as many hours as instructed
Then you wash and put on clean clothes
Bed linen and clothes are washed in hot water
feel: Itching can last another 2 to 4 weeks after treatment. This does not mean the treatment failed
after: Items that cannot be washed are usually sealed in a closed bag for a few days
Repeat the treatment only if the doctor prescribed it
If new rash appears after 2 to 4 weeks, come back for another visit
red_flags: Crusts, pus, swollen skin or fever: see a doctor

faq.a: No. You can catch it through close contact with a person who has scabies. Cleanliness does not fully protect.

faq.q: Why do I still itch after treatment?
faq.a: The skin still reacts to what is left of the mite. The itch passes in a few weeks. If it gets worse, see a doctor.

reminders.text: Scabies treatment this evening. Prepare clean bed linen and clothes for the whole family.
